description:
Second-pass review of round-1 fixes complete. No new bugs or regressions introduced by the 26 round-1 fixes. Three minor gaps filed as P2 children:
- JMAP-sz1.1.2: missing test for failed create + onSuccessUpdateEmail guard
- JMAP-sz1.1.3: Mailbox/set destroy silently skips non-string (pre-existing, not fixed in round-1)
- JMAP-sz1.1.4: no tests for Email/set and EmailSubmission/set destroy non-string invalidArguments guard

All 8 key areas checked: sendAt=now (OK), onSuccess creation ref guard (OK by construction), truncation (OK), TOCTOU mutex (OK - no async in lock), blob_exists default (OK - MemoryBackend overrides), OnceLock HashSet (complete), header colon parsing (OK - find(':') is correct for RFC 5322), destroy invalidArguments (correct per RFC 8620 §3.6.2).
title: R2 review complete: 3 minor gaps found, no regressions
